title: Close the warn gap that lets code and read resolve in silence
action: An audit found a locked decision violated and a user-facing text that lies about it. D2 (store 06e49368) says a role name nothing configures is WARNED, never silently accepted. ASKED_ROLES in models.rs exempts code and read from that warn, via role_is_unknown. On any host that has not opted in, a cell declaring role code — the FIRST word of the recommended vocabulary — resolves the generation model with NO warning: exactly the silently-accepted case D2 forbids. Worse, validate.rs's own FIX text promises the author that an unconfigured role falls through AND WARNS, which is false for the two names bee recommends first. The suppression was not arbitrary: mrs-9 added it because without it EVERY dispatch on an existing host warns, and a warning that always fires is one nobody reads — that reasoning is sound and is why this is a judgment cell, not a revert. Since then mrs-10 made a FRESH config ship code and read, so the gap only affects hosts that have not migrated. Weigh at least these and pick one, recording the choice as a decision with bee decisions log before you code: (a) warn once per process or per config rather than per dispatch, so it is heard without becoming noise; (b) keep the per-dispatch silence but make bee doctor or onboarding tell an un-migrated host to add the two keys, so the gap closes by migration rather than by warning; (c) narrow the exemption to the exact case that motivated it and let every other unconfigured name warn. Whatever you choose, validate.rs's FIX text must become TRUE — if some names do not warn, it must not promise they do. SECOND JOB, same file: D1 (store cd72ec97) says resolve_advisor collapses into the one parser, and it did not — it is still a standalone parser of the same value shapes beside resolve_configured. Collapse it, or record why it cannot be. Run your verify with --no-fail-fast.

truths: No role name resolves silently in a way D2 forbids, or the exemption is narrowed to a case a recorded decision justifies
The FIX text a cell author reads is true for every name, including code and read
A warning that fires on every dispatch of an un-migrated host is not the outcome
resolve_advisor no longer duplicates the one parser, or the cap records why it must stay
The chosen resolution is logged with bee decisions log, not only explained on the cap
